narrative.overview: A ledger is read, not admired. Every contact is a row of facts and the interface exists to put the right fact under the thumb quickly. Flat, ruled surfaces, one blue accent, system type. Light and dark both meet WCAG AA, and text follows the user's size setting.
keyCharacteristics: Flat surfaces separated by 1px borders; depth through tone, not shadow.
One accent color in three tones chosen by job: fill, text, decoration.
System font stack, sizes in rem, hierarchy through weight and size.
44px minimum touch targets and a bottom tab bar on mobile.
Skeletons, errors with retry, and empty states that mirror the final layout.
Quick actions (call, WhatsApp, email, copy) one tap from any contact or phone number.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue marks what can be acted on or what is current. If a blue element is neither, remove the blue.

rules.name: The Short Caps Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is reserved for section labels of four words or fewer.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards, rows and inputs carry no shadow at rest or on hover.

rules.name: The Job-Matched Token Rule
rules.body: Pick the blue or red by what it does: fill under white text, text on a surface, or decoration. Raw accent and danger never carry text.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: Secondary text on any surface keeps at least 4.5:1.

rules.name: The Rem Rule
rules.body: Never set a font size in px; text-holding containers grow or truncate instead of clipping.

dos: Do keep every touch target at 44px or larger, and keep primary navigation at the bottom on mobile.
Do match the blue or red to its job: Deep Signal under white text, Link Blue for text, Signal Blue for decoration.
Do separate surfaces with a 1px Hairline border and a tone shift.
Do make loading, empty and error states mirror the real layout, and give failed loads a retry.
Do size text in rem and check layouts at a 200 % text size.
Do keep text at 4.5:1 or better in both themes, and measure it instead of estimating.
Do give repeated controls names that include their target ("Agregar teléfono").
donts: Don't build a heavy corporate CRM: no endless forms, deep menus or visual noise.
Don't use generic template SaaS patterns: identical card grids, gradients, hero metrics.
Don't make it a decorative or childish app: no illustrations, emoji or animation that gets in the way of work.
Don't add shadows to cards, rows or inputs; the floating add button is the only exception.
Don't use border-left greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on rows or cards.
Don't use gradient text or glass effects as decoration.
Don't use a generic spinning icon for loading; use a skeleton that matches the layout.
Don't put raw --accent or --danger on text, or behind small white text.
Don't use role="menu" unless the control supports arrow-key navigation.
